name: Polynomial Field Integration via Coordinate Moments
definition: Integrates arbitrary scalar fields (or component-wise vector fields) by computing coordinate moments over each voxel and taking linear combinations using polynomial coefficients, avoiding the need to re-clip voxels for different fields.
summary: Polynomial Field Integration via Coordinate Moments computes voxel integrals by combining precomputed geometric moments with polynomial coefficients, enabling efficient simultaneous integration of multiple fields without redundant geometric clipping.
